name: GreatWait
tagline: Reliable webhook scheduling for your agent, your app, and you!
description: Schedule one-off or recurring HTTPS callbacks, inspect delivery history, and cancel scheduled work through GreatWait's remote MCP server.

install.notes: A GreatWait account is required. Authorize through OAuth and choose the project the connection can access. Review the requested permissions before approving. Setup and access details: https://docs.greatwait.dev/guides/mcp
